title: Mac-GPT: A Fine-Tuned Campus Assistant for Macalester College
authors: **Tenzin Gyaltsen**, Aalyan Arif Mahmood, Haris Ahmed, and Salman Ijaz.
summary: Fine-tuned a large language model on Macalester-specific data so students, faculty, and staff can ask natural-language questions about campus life, academics, and resources.

title: MySQL Spotify Database Emulator
summary: Designed and implemented a relational schema and queries modeling Spotify's music catalog, users, playlists, and listening history using MySQL.

title: Tetris Puzzle: iOS Game
authors: **Tenzin Gyaltsen**, Lily Ewing, and Sheida Rashidi Ardestani.
summary: Built an iOS puzzle game inspired by Tetris and tangrams with custom levels, animations, and touch controls under Professor Paul Cantrell's guidance.
